subject.title: fix(agents): apply stale-run liveness check to aborted subagent orphan recovery

question: Should this PR be accepted as the canonical fix for stale restart-aborted subagent runs, including the upgrade behavior that old persisted rows become pruned or terminal instead of resume-eligible?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it intentionally changes persisted session-state and parent-visible recovery semantics, and one open sibling PR overlaps the same canonical bug.
